authority: Draft for Darren and Barry review only. No queue registration, agent launch, branch mutation, merge, tag, deployment, upload, marketplace update, or global installation is authorized by publication.
evidence_contract: Acceptance binds to full source SHA(s), pinned dependency/spec revisions, clean isolated environment, exact commands and exit codes, required scenario counts with zero skips, artifact hashes, independent verdict, preserved behavior matrix, and rollback notes. Existing green CI does not override a reproducible contract violation.
title: Verify combined 0.7.3 artifacts and present one merge gate
problem: Independent PRs and source-tree tests do not prove that the released package/plugins preserve both development tracks or interoperate with OpenTalon.
outcome: One cross-repository release manifest binds reviewed spec/core/MCP/OT candidates, clean artifact evidence, migration/rollback results and residual risks for a consolidated operator merge decision. Release publication remains a separate gate.
hard_constraints: Refresh target tips and prove every accepted PRD's behavior is present on cumulative candidates. Test the combined trees after every conflict resolution; prior individual verdicts are not a substitute.
Build core/MCP wheel and sdist, Claude/Codex/Ollama plugins and supported Desktop .mcpb from clean isolated candidates. Test installed artifacts with repository source removed from import paths.

Verify pinned canonical dependency and offline vendored fallback separately. Package version, grammar version, protocol revision and each capability must agree with the manifest without being conflated.

Preserve Doctor/Verify and deterministic materialization; Desktop MCP support is not a claim of native SKILL.md support. Required conformance tests cannot skip due to missing fixtures, SDK or interpreter.
Exercise OT resource/event/task/lease adapters through supported boundaries in an isolated environment. No live runs, held approvals, production tasks or global installs may be used as test fixtures.
Produce one final merge proposal naming target branches, full candidate SHAs, merge order, rollback refs, migration backup and reversible deployment procedure. No intermediate stage/master merge.
Do not tag, upload to PyPI, publish a GitHub release, push a marketplace, globally install or activate production features. Those need explicit later release/deployment authority.
